$comment: Pinned apps for the Quick Apps menu (Mod+Shift+Space, decisions.md §8). Edit this file by hand to add/remove/reorder entries -- source of truth per decisions.md §8 choice A. 'id' should match a Quickshell DesktopEntries id (visible via the Launcher's app list); unresolvable ids are skipped with a console warning, not a crash. 'label' is what's shown when the .desktop entry's own name is undesired.
